name: sgs/testimonial
title: SGS Testimonial
description: Single testimonial with 7 layout variants — quote, attribution, optional avatar, organisation logo, work media, and a fully optional rating.

sgs._comment_orgLogoNotAdopted: orgLogo's object-fit:contain (style.css) is deliberately NOT a client control and NOT routed through the media-atom layer -- a logo must never be cropped, so there is no orgLogoObjectFit attribute to adopt in the first place. Disclosed here (in addition to the existing style.css comment) for consistency with the other _comment_*NotAdopted notes added during the 37-media-no-handroll remediation, per /qc-council 2026-09-03.
sgs._comment_mediaElements: 37-media-no-handroll remediation (2026-09-03). Replaces the old universal imageControls/imageControlsExplicit single sgsObjectFit/sgsObjectPosition pair (block-level, shared by whichever slot's render.php happened to call sgs_media_position_css()) with two independently-scoped media elements, one per slot, mirroring sgs/before-after's Wave 5b migration. `avatar` gets object-fit only (a fixed-crop circular headshot has no genuine focal-point need beyond the fit mode). `work` gets object-fit + focal-point, replacing the position control the old mechanism gave it 1:1 — case-study media varies in composition, so both crop mode and crop focus are genuine per-instance needs. The org logo is deliberately excluded — see elements.org-logo-image below.

quote-box.label: Quote box
quote-box._note_animation: FR-35-6 — the scroll-reveal preset (sgsAnimation/sgsAnimationDuration/sgsAnimationEasing) + staggerDelay resolve via explicit attrMap (no `prefix` declared, per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). anim:parallax/anim:trigger are honest gaps — no bgParallax/scroll-trigger attrs on this block.

quote-text.label: Quote text
quote-text._note: quoteMarginBottom (render.php:153,241, `'margin-bottom' => $quote_margin_bot`) resolves via the new css:margin-bottom layout member (Spec 35 vocabulary fix). quoteColourGradient (D636 Task 1b) is the text-colour gradient sibling to quoteColour — background-clip:text mechanism; the 'fill' cluster was added solely to place this member.

reviewer-name.label: Reviewer name
reviewer-name._note_hover: Hover colour declared 2026-09-05. Previously these five pushed a bare `color:` into the shared root $hover_decls bucket (render.php, emitted against $root_sel), so they collided with each other (only the last survived) AND could never reach this element, which sets its own explicit resting colour. render.php now emits a per-element ancestor-hover rule ($root_sel:hover/:focus-within + this element's resting selector), matching the pattern quoteColourHover already used correctly, so this declaration is now truthful.

avatar-image.label: Avatar image
avatar-image._note: 37-media-no-handroll remediation (2026-09-03) — REVERSES the 2026-08-17 note this used to carry. The circular cover-crop is still the component-owned DEFAULT (style.css's hardcoded object-fit:cover was removed; the shared `.sgs-media-el{object-fit:var(--sgs-media-object-fit,cover)}` atom stylesheet now paints the identical default), but it is no longer immovable — a client can override it per instance via the `avatar` mediaElements entry above (`avatarObjectFit`/`avatarObjectFitTablet`/`avatarObjectFitMobile`, auto-registered server-side from supports.sgs.mediaElements — see includes/media-element-attrs-register.php). Border-radius:50% stays a genuine fixed constant (a non-circular avatar is not a supported shape here). Rendered inside a plain `<div>` (render.php) — the marker classes are added explicitly via SGS_Media_Element::element_classes(), not via the generic render_block guessing injector, so the plain-`<div>` wrapper is no longer a reachability problem.

org-logo-image.label: Organisation logo
org-logo-image._note: Deliberately NOT reachable by the universal image-controls mechanism (design decision, 2026-08-17): style.css:101-107 fixes object-fit:contain — a logo must never be cropped, so this is a component-owned constant, not a client-overridable style. Same 'plain `<div>` wrapper, never reached by the generic mechanism anyway' reasoning as avatar-image above.

work-media.label: Work / case-study media
work-media._note: 37-media-no-handroll remediation (2026-09-03) — migrated off the old block-level imageControls/imageControlsExplicit + sgs_media_position_css() mechanism (design decision, 2026-08-17) onto the independently-scoped `work` mediaElements entry above (object-fit + focal-point), matching sgs/before-after's Wave 5b precedent 1:1. Still the one image slot with a genuine per-instance crop need — case-study photos vary in composition/aspect ratio, unlike the fixed-crop avatar/logo slots. SGS_Media_Element::element_classes()/style() target the same known `.sgs-testimonial__work img, .sgs-testimonial__work video` selector explicitly in render.php; the generic render_block guessing injector is still never relied on.

summary._note:
The summary phrase —

(render.php:699), styled at render.php:276-283 (color <- summaryColour, font-size <- summaryFontSize). A SEPARATE element from quote-text, which is the

(render.php:704, styled :288-309): two different DOM nodes, so one entry cannot cover both, and quote-text's prefix "quote" can never reach a summary* attribute. attributes._comment_artDirection: Art-direction tiers (2026-08-07) — the {base}/{base}Tablet/{base}Mobile shape sgs/media and sgs/hero use, object-typed to MATCH avatarMedia (a flat value on an object-typed attr is silently coerced to the default, dropping the whole thing). A tier left empty falls back to the desktop avatar at that width. Deliberately NOT sgs_render_media()'s existing `mobile_url` <picture> path: that is mobile-only, has no tablet step, and is not the BEM tier modifier the cloning pipeline's draft vocabulary reads — one convention on both ends is what makes a clone round-trip.

avatarDecorative.description: Item 18 (WCAG 1.1.1) — the reviewer photo carries no information beyond decoration; hides it from assistive tech (empty alt + aria-hidden) instead of storing/announcing the media library's alt text.

orgLogoDecorative.description: Item 18 (WCAG 1.1.1) — the organisation logo is purely decorative for this instance; hides it from assistive tech (empty alt + aria-hidden) instead of storing/announcing the media library's alt text.

workMediaDecorative.description: Item 18 (WCAG 1.1.1) — the case-study work image/video is purely decorative for this instance; hides it from assistive tech (empty alt + aria-hidden) instead of storing/announcing the media library's alt text.

quoteFontStyle.description: Font style for the quote text. 'italic' or empty for normal.

quoteLineHeight.description: Line height for the quote text. Raw CSS value (e.g. 1.6, 2em). Empty = default.

quoteMarginBottom.description: Space below the quote text. Raw CSS value (e.g. 16px, 1.5rem). Empty = theme default (spacing--30).

nameFontSize.description: Reviewer-name font size, per-device tier {desktop,tablet,mobile} (Spec 35 tier-object shape). Empty object = inherit the theme default (style.css var(--wp--preset--font-size--small)). Rendered via the shared sgs_typography_css_rule() helper, scoped to .sgs-testimonial__name.

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover-state border with a masked ::before ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColourHover on hover — this block has no resting-state border colour attribute of its own to override (native __experimentalBorder.color, unaffected).

attributes._comment_wrapperAttrs: WS-4 container-mirror (CONTENT kind): width/spacing only — mirrored verbatim from sgs/container block.json.
attributes._comment_boxTiers: No-inline migration contract §B: tablet/mobile tier overrides for the WP-native style.spacing.padding/margin base (paddingTablet/paddingMobile/marginTablet/marginMobile).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

attributes.quote: The quality and reliability of the service has been outstanding from start to finish.
